# Tecnológico Superior de Libres

> > Official website of the Instituto Tecnológico Superior de Libres (ITSLibres), a campus of the Tecnológico Nacional de México offering engineering programs and technical education.

ITSLibres serves students in Libres, Puebla with undergraduate engineering programs, professional residencies, and ISO-certified quality standards. The institution provides comprehensive student services including enrollment, academic procedures, and online learning through Moodle.

## Key Topics

- Instituto Tecnológico Superior de Libres
- ITSLibres
- Tecnológico Nacional de México
- Engineering programs (ingeniería)
- Student services (servicios escolares)
- Professional residencies (residencias profesionales)
- Social service (servicio social)
- Online learning and Moodle
- ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications
- Campus Libres
- Academic divisions (divisiones académicas)
- Technology management (gestión tecnológica)
- Mexican technical institute education
- Institutional directory and contacts

## Institutional Information

- [Tecnológico Superior de Libres](https://libres.tecnm.mx/): Homepage of Tecnológico Nacional de México Campus Libres

- [Directorio](https://libres.tecnm.mx/templates/conocenos/Directorio.html): Staff directory with administrative contacts and academic divisions

## Student Services

- [Servicios Escolares](https://libres.tecnm.mx/templates/departamentos/escolares.html): Student services for enrollment, certificates, and academic procedures
- [Gestión Tecnológica](https://libres.tecnm.mx/templates/departamentos/GTecnologica.html): Technology management: professional residencies and social service info
